about: The tamper guard of 0.5.1 (tag v0.5.1, 62b795b) and of 0.5.2 (tag v0.5.2, c9d8ffc) on real history: .github/workflows/tamper-bench.yml, run 44128788594 of 2026-11-17, ran bench/tamper-history.mjs with both release binaries over the recorded commits of the sixteen public repos of bench/tamper-history.json (M26) and bench/tamper-history-m32.json (M32). A finding that an earlier file labels (same repo, commit, kind, file and text) keeps that label and reason (`labelFrom` names the file). The 51 findings no earlier file labels were labelled on 2026-11-18 by one fresh AI subagent, once, from the commit's message, file list and diff and a neutral statement of the claim; it did not see the guard's code. No person checked any label. clap-rs/clap and pallets/flask gave fewer commits than were recorded (94 of 150 and 51 of 150): `commits` is what this run read, `recordedCommits` what M26 read.
